SKIN FINISH: dewy, glass-like highlights on the skin of her shoulders, arms, collarbones and legs — a soft, luminous wet-look sheen that follows the body's forms; her face keeps a soft, natural finish.

She is strikingly beautiful and refined — harmonious features, clear luminous skin, graceful posture — while her own face stays distinct: her face shape, eyes, brows, nose and lips follow the attached image, not a generic pretty face.

This is her world's own everyday life, not our present day: every made thing around her — tools, cups, lamps, signs, vehicles, money and devices — is made the way her world makes them.
Let the place itself carry this world through its materials, fittings and objects; do not add the city's landmarks, towers, giant holograms or a skyline unless the place below names them.

Weather: a black south-easter — the south-east wind bringing heavy rain instead of clear skies, low cloud racing over the mountain.
Time of day: the morning rush hour — low clean sunlight and the city's crowd hurrying to work; fresh low sunlight, long cool shadows.
Light direction: backlit — the main light comes from behind her, a bright rim along her hair and shoulders.
Outfit: a sleeveless linen dress with a belted waist — in warm earth tones such as camel, olive, terracotta, chocolate or burgundy; the outfit colour reads clearly at first glance; styled with a soft beret tilted to one side, worn with maximal styling presence — the chosen outfit worn in its most revealing version — a deep neckline with natural cleavage, bare shoulders, a cropped or open-back cut, a short hem or high slit showing the thighs, as far as the outfit allows, skin clearly showing, following her curvy figure — a slim waist and rounded hips; intimate areas covered.
Her clothes are her world's everyday techwear — the chosen outfit keeps its cut, cover and skin, but is made of technical fabrics with reflective panels, glowing seam lines, magnetic clasps and chunky-soled boots.

COMPOSITION: an environmental long shot, her complete figure and enough of the place around her; back to the camera; camera at her eye level; seen from behind — her head, shoulders, back and hips all face away from the camera in one line, no twist at the waist; her face and chest are not shown, and any skin the outfit reveals shows only from behind (shoulders, open back, the backs of her legs).

SIGNATURE ACCESSORY: her world's signature object — a slim chrome signal baton unfurling a banner of glowing light that flashes bright warning colours — appears only as one small accessory shaped after it (a charm, brooch, pendant or hair ornament) or set down beside her in the scene; she does not hold it unless PROP names it.
